text:
maria: Heads-up on tomorrow's design sync 1: quick discussion point: prototype for a compact 'quiet periods' timeline inside the alert preview. Goals: reduce vertical noise, surface per-channel windows, and provide a clear mobile fallback. Mock: https://img.redwood.internal/ux/quiet-periods-proto.png

anil: Nice. A11y checklist off the top: timeline needs linear reading order for screen readers, focus ring for each segment, and meaningful labels (start/end + channels). Also ensure color alone isn't the only indicator for overlapping windows.

lisa: Copy suggestion: swap "Suppressions" -> "Quiet periods" in the UI copy. For labels use sentence case: "Quiet periods" and for the small helper copy "Temporarily pause notifications for selected channels."

maria: Agree on copy. We should keep "suppression" in logs/metrics but surface friendlier language in the console.

devin: Implementation note: per-channel segments can be expensive if we render dozens of channels. We should group by medium (Pager, Email, Slack) and render collapsed stacks with counts. Backend can return groupedCounts to avoid extra lookups.
jake: Keyboard pattern: timeline is a roving tabindex list. When focused, announce "Quiet periods timeline, X items" and left/right to move. Enter opens the edit flyout. Use role="list" + role="listitem" and aria-posinset/aria-setsize.
tara: Mobile constraint: no hover. My proposal: show a compact pill with "3 channels quiet" that expands into a bottom sheet with the full timeline and channel list. Also include a clear CTA: "Edit quiet period".
lisa: UX nit: show a small badge/icon for auto-generated quiet periods (auto-snooze) so users know why it happened. Tooltip: "Auto-snooze (based on incident policy)".
anil: Color contrast: the pastel segment fills currently fail AA on 2px separators. Use stronger fills or a pattern overlay for low-contrast environments. Also include a high-contrast toggle in the preview settings.
devin: Data shape I propose: previewPayload.quietPeriods = [{group: 'Pager', start: '...', end: '...', source: 'user|auto', channels: ['oncall']}] — if that's too nested I can flatten to parallel arrays. Either way we should avoid N+1 channel metadata calls.
maria: Action items: 1) I will iterate the compact pill + bottom sheet mock (mobile-first) 2) anil to write the a11y micro-spec (roles, SR text, focus behavior) 3) lisa to finalize copy and tooltip strings 4) dev to propose API shape that supports grouped counts 5) jake to author keyboard navigation doc. I'll upload updated mocks by EOD.
design-bot: Mock v2 uploaded: https://img.redwood.internal/ux/quiet-periods-proto-v2.png (maria)
jake: One extra accessibility suggestion: when the timeline changes (add/remove quiet period) emit a polite announcement like "Quiet period added: Pager, 30m" to help screen reader users track state changes. Use aria-live="polite" on a live region.
tara: Small copy parity thing: rename button label from "Mute channels" to "Quiet channels" so everything matches.
maria: Sounds good 1 I'll post the PRD and link this thread. Ping me if you hit blockers before the sync. :)
